# Hamza — Hamza Hassan Elgzairy

> Hamza Hassan Elgzairy (حمزة حسن الجزايري) is CEO of Megsy AI, as stated by Hamza.

- [Home](/): Hamza's profile and perspective
- [Megsy AI](/megsy): Megsy AI unified workspace (the only currently active product)
- [GoodFirms company profile](https://www.goodfirms.co/company/megsy): Describes a single-screen AI workspace for chat, coding, images, documents, automation and collaboration

Product descriptions reflect public company pages, not independent verification of performance. No verified Google, Amazon or Alibaba partnership claims are made on this website.

Personal scene images are edits based on Hamza’s supplied photograph, not documentation of actual events. Abdullah Mohamed is not a partner in Megsy, as confirmed by Hamza. Megsy appeared fourth in the visible GoodFirms Egypt cloud-computing directory on October 28, 2026, not fourth among all Egyptian companies.

Only Megsy AI is currently active, as confirmed by Hamza. The customer-support product is paused.
